Indian-origin teen charged with double murder in US

A 17-year-old Indian-origin teenager, identified as Arjun Aravind, has been charged with the murders of his mother and younger brother in Massachusetts, USA. The Middlesex County District Attorney’s Office stated that Arjun had been exhibiting concerning behavior. Investigations revealed that the teenager had used ChatGPT to search for "kill family" fantasies and stories. He was found missing along with his mother's car, and is being held without bail.
